title: Attack Selection Against Weak Trusted Monitors: A Concentrated-Setting Replication

original_idea.body: Use a strong open model as attacker and a weak one as trusted monitor, compare random vs monitor-score-filtered attacks, and measure the catch-rate drop replicating the concentrated-setting claim.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Quantifying attack-selection against weak trusted monitors in concentrated settings addresses a UK AISI priority.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Strong attacker plus weak monitor, random vs selected attacks, measure catch-rate drop; inherited methodology.

novelty.reasoning: Direct replication of a Feb 2026 result; open-weights quantification adds some value.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Replication of an existing claim; open-model magnitude may be open.
